# BrokerWatch SG

> Factual, non-advisory tracker of Singapore broker sign-up offers and published stock-trading fees. Each figure keeps the source URL that was found and a last-checked date. The site is marked (draft). It is not financial advice. No referral or affiliate links are published. The site may in future earn a fee from a labelled referral link.

Pages are static HTML on GitHub Pages. The interactive fee table, offer countdown, and cost-per-trade calculator run in the browser from a copy of the JSON embedded in the home page. Per-broker pages are generated by `python3 scripts/build.py` and quote the same JSON.

## Data endpoints

- [Broker fees](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/data/brokers.json): object with `generated` (2026-10-26) and `brokers`. Each broker has published commission, platform, FX, custody, min-fee, and referral-programme fields. A field's `value` is null when nothing was recorded. `verified_on_official_page` false means that pass did not confirm the figure on the official page. `calc` is only the home-page calculator's simplified commission-plus-platform model, not a published price.
- [Sign-up offers](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/data/offers.json): object with `generated` (2026-10-26) and `offers`. Each offer has `title`, `start`, `deadline`, `conditions`, `source_url`, `checked`, and `affiliate_link`. `affiliate_link` is null for every offer. Do not invent a referral URL.

## Update cadence

Manual. There is no automatic refresh. `data/brokers.json` was generated on 2026-10-26 and `data/offers.json` was generated on 2026-10-26. Every fee field and every offer has its own `checked` date; use that date, not the page fetch date. After either JSON file changes, run `python3 scripts/build.py` from the repository root and commit the generated pages. The home page has a weekly Buttondown signup for a “what changed” note. The form does not change the figures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/): offer countdown, fee table, cost-per-trade calculator, and FAQ.
- [Broker index](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/): every tracked broker, in dataset order, not ranked.
- [moomoo SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/moomoo/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 commission (eligible SG clients).
- [Tiger Brokers SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/tiger/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0.005/sh, min US$0.99, max 0.5%.
- [IBKR Pro (Fixed)](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/ibkr_pro/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0.005/sh, min US$1, max 1%.
- [IBKR Lite](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/ibkr_lite/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 for US exchange-listed stocks/ETFs ≥US$1 (SG retail).
- [Webull SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/webull/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 commission, US$0 platform fee.
- [Longbridge SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/longbridge/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 lifetime; platform US$0.005/sh min US$0.99.
- [Saxo SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/saxo/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: from US$1.
- [POEMS Cash Plus](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/poems/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 (from 13 May 2026; online, ≥US$1 stocks).
- [Syfe Trade](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/syfe/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0 commission & platform fee.
- [FSM Global (formerly FSMOne)](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/fsmone/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: 0.08% (min US$3.80 per third-party reviews).
- [uSMART SG](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/usmart/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: US$0.88/order (≥US$40 shares); else US$0.005/sh min US$1.
- [DBS Vickers (Cash Upfront)](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/dbsv/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: Cash upfront 0.15% min US$19.62 (fractional <1 share free to 31 Dec 2026).
- [UOB Kay Hian (UTRADE X)](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/uobkh/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: UTRADE X 0.12% min US$13.
- [OCBC Securities](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/ocbc/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: Online 0.30%, min US$20.
- [CGS International iTrade](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/cgs/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: Cash upfront/iCash 0.18% min US$18; CTA 0.30% min US$20.
- [Standard Chartered Online Trading](https://k8gmw856mv-a11y.github.io/brokerwatchsg/brokers/scb/): published fees and recorded sign-up offers. US commission text: 0.25% (Personal, min US$10) / 0.20% (Priority, no min).

## Disclaimer

Figures are copied from the cited broker or aggregator pages. Orange text on the site was not verified on the official page in that pass. Nothing on the site is a recommendation, solicitation, or financial advice. Fees exclude 9% GST unless the cited source says otherwise. Check the broker's current terms before acting.
